notes.title: GALLERY NEWS + SPECIAL GUEST ㊙️ HAREM FANTASY 🐉
notes.content:
Hi everyone 🤗

[i][b]Are you excited for the news? Buckle up, we have a lot in our pockets! [/b][/i]

First of all, [u][b]the gallery feature[/b][/u] has finally gone to the testing stage! You can expect an update very soon, once we’re done testing it and making sure it doesn’t break anything. You will be able to access all the opened scenes through the main menu and repeat all the favorite scenes whenever you like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/749590d82b4cbae9ed412bc878feb9d0f9e9ebbc.png[/img]

Secondly, we’re starting to work on the [b]DLC[/b] once we’re done polishing the gallery. We have everything planned out already, so, please, stay tuned for the news, we’re gonna be dropping them very soon. 

And last, but certainly, not least, a small announcement for you:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/7a1e95299f7c4e6a21c556c8b6ed5205ce47cc6e.png[/img]

Today is a special day - our long-time friends, whom we have known for 1000 years... No, a little less! Anyways, We’ve known them for a very long time, but that’s beside the point. Our friends have decided to make their own game 🎮 Having worked all summer and tried their best, the guys finally announce the first project on Steam - [b]Harem Fantasy[/b] ⛩️ We encourage everyone who cares to look at this miracle and add the game to your wishlist if you like it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886870

[h2]GAME FEATURES:[/h2]
㊙️ A fantasy Ancient Asia setting
🌸 Hot girls with unique personalities
🍜 Delicate art with an Asian style vibe
🌶️ Lots of H-scenes, fully animated and voiced
🎭 Various text based mini-games
⚡ 6 different endings
☯️ The game features optional femboy and futa characters

[h3]👑 THE HAREM AWAITS ITS NEW RULER 👑[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/ada81e5689186f6abad7d0923a2b2ec2d294e1f5.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/51bf435c197cad1271ad8c257095e4e64270108b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/e861466286b239cc51b9dba4412a01797e0f9ff2.jpg[/img]

❓ Will your hands be able to heal not only the body, but also the hearts  and souls of the beauties? Who will fall under your seduction, and whose seduction will bring you down? Will you be able to unravel the conspiracies, stay alive and perhaps seize power over the Celestial Empire?

[b]Massages, elixirs, secret dates, and treacherous plans — all this awaits you behind the gates of the harem.[/b]

Seduce. Heal. Investigate. ⤵️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/531090f36475b9a903179ecf913a5edafd70b5c4.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3886870

🌐 JOIN THE GUYS’ [url=https://discord.gg/rgmdvh3Zjw]DISCORD SERVER[/url], there is a giveaway of Steam keys!

Please, support the guys with their first game. Each of your wishlists will motivate them to work even faster and better, so that the game is eventually released on time! They also asked me to attach a Development Roadmap:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45482272/575ffab3ebe623bcd140f09e6d64f56375ceade9.png[/img]
